authority_note: Prototype inspired by the UIDAI Aadhaar enrolment journey. Not affiliated with or endorsed by UIDAI. Requirement values below are illustrative demo configuration.
journey_note: This prototype prepares the digital/document portion of the journey. Real Aadhaar enrolment requires visiting an Aadhaar Enrolment Centre for biometric capture.

applicant_types.label: Adult (18 years and above)
applicant_types.description: Applying for yourself. You will need identity, address and date-of-birth proof.

applicant_types.label: Child (5 to 17 years)
applicant_types.description: A parent or guardian applies on the child's behalf and provides their own proof of identity.

applicant_types.label: Child (below 5 years)
applicant_types.description: Enrolment is linked to a parent or guardian. Birth certificate and relationship proof are required.

identity_proof.label: Proof of Identity
identity_proof.help: A document showing your name and photograph.

address_proof.label: Proof of Address
address_proof.help: A recent document showing your name and current address.

dob_proof.label: Proof of Date of Birth
dob_proof.help: A document that states your date of birth.

relationship_proof.label: Proof of Relationship
relationship_proof.help: A document linking the child to the parent or guardian.

photograph.label: Passport-size photograph
photograph.help: A clear, front-facing photograph on a plain background.
